decision: The measured c32 arm already realizes the available pinned-vLLM continuous-decode packing mechanism. No semantics-preserving scheduler/admission arm distinct from raising concurrency has identified non-overlapping leverage for the required 700.649 tok/s endpoint.

source_mechanism.running_first: scheduler.py:342-487 schedules every running request while token_budget remains.
source_mechanism.admission_limit: scheduler.py:538-540 admits waiting work only after running work and only while len(running) < max_num_running_reqs.
source_mechanism.decode_capacity: For ordinary decode each live request consumes one token per iteration; 32 <= 65536, so the token budget cannot truncate a full c32 decode iteration.
source_mechanism.consequence: At c32, max_num_seqs=32 is the binding packing limit and all admitted decode requests are packed. FCFS versus another waiting policy cannot change a full running decode iteration.

candidate_audit.evidence: archive server.stdout.log reports Chunked prefill is enabled with max_num_batched_tokens=65536
archive server.stdout.log reports Asynchronous scheduling is enabled

candidate_audit.candidate: change scheduling policy or prefill admission
candidate_audit.evidence: waiting policy is reached only after the running-first loop; c32 is already full at max_num_seqs=32
65536-token budget already exceeds the 32 one-token decode demand by over three orders of magnitude; raising it does not increase live decode count
pinned source sets lookahead only when speculative configuration is present; the measured server has speculative_config=null and the project excludes speculative decoding

measured_context.phase_attribution: depth42_c32_phase_attribution identifies continuous decode batching from more simultaneously live sequences; it does not identify an additional scheduler submechanism.

falsification_standard: A nomination would need a source-bound change that increases scheduled decode work beyond the already-full 32-request iteration, or removes independently measured critical-path time. Neither condition holds. No theoretical queue-overlap or utilization time is converted into saved wall time.
next_action: Closed; do not launch a scheduler arm from this project.
